tldr: Sun in the 8th house: identity and vitality center on intimacy, shared resources, and transformation
body: Sun in the 8th house: identity and vitality center on intimacy, shared resources, and transformation. Gift: you shine there. Watch: ego tied to it. With the Sun in the 8th house, identity, vitality, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center move through shared resources, trust, intimacy, debt, grief, and deep repair. This makes how you merge, trust, release control, and handle what cannot stay superficial a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose. Left unconscious, it can become over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through shared depth and vulnerability.
challenge: over-identifying with this area, needing recognition here, or confusing attention with self-worth concentrated in shared depth and vulnerability.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
